_about.chapter: Progression: Resonance (949's levels), the three tuning trees, castable abilities, and the perks closeness unlocks.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.progression and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Node ids, tree ids and ability ids are in save files: never rename one. A "note" is for people only.

tables.resonance: Level rules (read as RESONANCE, core/resonance.js). CAP: top level. level_cost: Resonance from level L to the next = base + per_level x L. DEATH_LOSS: share of unsettled Resonance lost on death. RESPEC_COST and POST_CAP_XP_PER_PP: in PP. BASE: Resonance per kill by enemy class; USUAL_HP: the HP that base assumes (tougher pays up to 3x). FLIT_KILL, PUNCH, UNTOUCHED, POISE: style multipliers; CHAIN_STEP per chained kill up to CHAIN_MAX; FLIT_WINDOW, CHAIN_WINDOW, UNTOUCHED_SECS in seconds; TEAMMATE_SHARE: share for a crew kill; POISE_LEVEL: drink level for POISE.
tables.trees: The three trees of six nodes (read as RESONANCE_TREES). Each node has up to 3 ranks; a node opens once the one above it has a rank; unlockLevel gates it by level. per_rank: the node's numbers, multiplied by its rank (shares are 0.10 = 10%, times in seconds unless the name says frames). The text the tuning screen shows is built from these in core/resonance.js (RESONANCE_NODE_TEXT). last_stand.cooldown_secs is indexed by rank; double_step halves a flit's cost (half_cost) within half_cost_window s of the last one from rank half_cost_rank; grounded.slip_secs is added to SPILL.SLIP_SECS (engine/spills.js).
tables.abilities: Castable abilities (read as ABILITY_REGISTRY, ui/inventory-augments.js). stats.fireRate: frames between casts; projectileSpeed px per frame; projectileLife frames; range px; spread radians.
tables.talk_perks: What closeness with a person unlocks, by name and closeness tier (read as TALK_PERKS, story/talks.js).
